episodes.title: Goodbye, Summer Days
episodes.summary: Shinpei returns home for his friend Ushio's funeral. She apparently drowned, but something is off.

episodes.title: Shadows
episodes.summary: To find out the truth about Ushio's death, Shinpei and Mio head to Hiruko.

episodes.title: Drifting Ashore
episodes.summary: After being stabbed by Mio's shadow, Shinpei regains consciousness at the docks on July 22nd.

episodes.title: Jamais-vu
episodes.summary: Ushio's shadow appears before Shinpei at the summer festival.

episodes.title: Maelstrom
episodes.summary: A giant shadow massacres everyone at the Hitogashima Summer Festival and engulfs the whole island.

episodes.title: Orbital Resonance
episodes.summary: Hizuru Minakata, the woman on the ferry, returns to Hitogashima Island hoping to solve a mystery.

episodes.title: Deadly Enemy
episodes.summary: In order to defeat the Kobayakawa's shadows, Shinpei and Hizuru join forces with Nezu.

episodes.title: Memento
episodes.summary: Mio's shadow appears before Shinpei and threatens him with a knife.

episodes.title: My Flowing Tears
episodes.summary: In a video, Ushio and her shadow recount their encounter up to the moment the video is recorded.

episodes.title: Into the Darkness
episodes.summary: Shinpei gains clues on Mount Takanosu since Ushio and her shadow had gone there.

episodes.title: Dinner Time
episodes.summary: Ushio, Sou and Shinpei are surrounded by shadows.

episodes.title: Bloody Night
episodes.summary: Tokiko, Sou's younger sister, reveals she has been offering corpses as food to Hiruko.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.summary: It is the fifth July 22nd for Shinpei. Hizuru takes time to process that Shinpei is a time traveler.

episodes.title: to be/not to be
episodes.summary: Shinpei finds himself in Hizuru's memories from fourteen years ago.

episodes.title: Lights, Camera, Action
episodes.summary: Heine, who loops like Shinpei, realizes the pattern of behavior when a new loop begins.

episodes.title: Original
episodes.summary: Mio proposes to turn the shadows into allies.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.summary: Shinpei hears about Shide's identity from Sou's father, Director of Hishigata Clinic.

episodes.title: Meeting
episodes.summary: A seventy-year-old photograph reveals the truth.

episodes.title: Maid in Black
episodes.summary: Karikiri and Heine strike. Mio and Hizuru learn of Ushio's death.

episodes.title: All is (not) lost.
episodes.summary: Hizuru and Karikiri face off, while Gil and Rose enter the fray.

episodes.title: Ajiro Shinpei's Longest Day
episodes.summary: Shinpei despairs over Hizuru's death. However, hope is on the horizon.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Ushio fully comes back to life. Shinpei heads to Hiruko's grotto.

episodes.title: Eternal Night
episodes.summary: After slicing down Heine, Shide brings Shinpei and Ushio to her home.

episodes.title: Summertime Re-Rendering
episodes.summary: After a fierce battle, Shinpei takes the place of an exhausted Ushio and confronts Shide.

episodes.title: I'm Home
episodes.summary: Shide is gone and Ushio's final iteration must vanish. Shinpei comes to on the morning of July 22nd.
